profile.title: Profile Settings
profile.description: Update your birth details to recalculate your chart and interpretations.
profile.rectification_description: Refine an uncertain birth time. The rectified time recomputes your chart; your originally-entered time is kept for reference.
profile.ascendant_error: Could not preview the Ascendant for this time.
profile.ascendant_unavailable: Ascendant preview unavailable — the engine is still starting.
profile.ascendant_prompt: Set a birth date and location to preview the Ascendant.
profile.cusp_warning: ⚠ ~{{degrees}}° from {{sign}} — your rising sign is on a cusp; small birth-time changes flip it.
profile.comparison_near: {{sign}} rises only ~{{degrees}}° from the {{neighbour}} cusp. A few minutes' difference in your recorded time would make it {{neighbour}} and shift every house by one sign — the same person at two candidate times.
profile.comparison_flip: Same person, two candidate times: the rising sign changes {{recorded}} → {{rectified}}, so every house shifts by one sign. Weigh this against your life events — it is a possibility, not a verdict.
profile.confidence_hint: Your birth time is {{confidence}}. There is no automatic rectification — you refine it here by hand: nudge the rectified time, watch the Ascendant above, and weigh it against your real life events. This matters most when the lagna sits on a cusp, where minutes flip the rising sign.
profile.location_hint: Timezone will be automatically determined from your location.
profile.regeneration_required_description: Changing birth date, time, or location recomputes your chart on-device.
profile.engine_starting: The on-device engine is still starting. Please try again in a moment.
profile.success_description: Your birth details have been updated and your chart has been regenerated on-device.
profile.processing_description: Computing on-device — this only takes a moment.

people.mesh_ready_one: Mesh ready — {{count}} person connected to you
people.mesh_ready_other: Mesh ready — {{count}} people connected to you
people.empty_body: Add the people close to you — family first. Each person gets a real chart of their own, computed on this device; the mesh will weave their skies into yours.
people.add_hint: Next you'll enter their birth details — their chart is computed entirely on this device.
people.add_failed: Something went wrong while adding this person. Please try again.

ai.title: AI Model
ai.description: AI is off by default — your chart is pure calculation. Turn it on with a free OpenRouter key for written interpretations and chat. Your key lives only in this browser, and AI is never required to draw a chart.
ai.info_title: The chart engine never calls the network
ai.info_description: By default no AI is configured: your chart is pure calculation and never leaves your device. If you connect AI, optional narration, chat, and life-event organization can use it. Chart prompts are privacy-redacted (no name or birth date); life-event text is sent as written only after its separate disclosure.
ai.step1_body: OpenRouter gives you one endpoint with hundreds of models. Sign up and create a key — it takes a minute.
ai.step2_hint: Paste your key above to enable.
ai.error_auth: API key rejected. Check that you pasted your OpenRouter key correctly.
ai.error_model: That model isn't available. Check the model id under Advanced.
ai.error_credits: Your provider account is out of credits. Add credits and try again.
ai.error_privacy: This endpoint isn't local. Tick "Allow a cloud endpoint" under Advanced before sending optional AI content off-device.
ai.error_network: Couldn't reach the endpoint. Check the URL and your internet connection.
ai.error_unknown: Couldn't connect. Please check your settings and try again.
ai.error_rate_limited: The provider is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
ai.error_reasoning_timeout: The model thought for over 3 minutes without answering. Try again, or pick a faster model.
ai.error_server: The provider is having trouble right now. Try again shortly.
ai.error_storage: Couldn't save your settings in this browser — storage may be full or blocked (e.g. private mode). Free up space or try a normal window.
ai.credits_unavailable: Couldn't read your balance right now.
ai.credits_note: OpenRouter bills prepaid credits in US dollars, not tokens.
ai.advanced_hint: Enter an endpoint above to enable.
ai.advanced_summary: Advanced: use a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
ai.advanced_body: Point AlmaMesh at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — a local model (e.g. Ollama) or another provider. Chart prompts are privacy-redacted. Life-event text is sent as written only when you submit it after the disclosure.
ai.allow_cloud_label: Allow a cloud endpoint for optional AI content
ai.api_key_label: API key (stored only in this browser)
ai.privacy_warning: Privacy mode is local-only but the endpoint is not local — the connection will be refused until you either use a local endpoint or allow a cloud endpoint above.

aiModels.interpretation_advice: The default, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, is fast and cheap: in our tests it wrote the full timeline in about 50 seconds for about 2 cents. A bigger model may write deeper prose, but takes longer.
aiModels.switch_body: You're on GLM 5.3 Flash. In our tests (3 runs each), DeepSeek V4.1 Flash wrote the whole timeline in about 50 s every time. GLM 5.3 Flash showed nothing for over a minute in 2 of 3 runs and took 200 s in the one that finished.
aiModels.chat_advice: A smaller, faster model is advised. Chat already reuses the chart facts and the generated reading, so it doesn't need a heavy model — a quick one keeps answers snappy.
aiModels.catalog_hint: Pick from {{count}} OpenRouter models — or type any model id.
aiModels.catalog_unavailable: Couldn't load the model list — type your model id.

tiers.none_body: Your chart is pure calculation — it never leaves your device. AI narration stays off.
tiers.cloud_body: Add written interpretations and chat with an OpenRouter key (recommended) or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Only a privacy-redacted chart prompt leaves your device. If you use AI to organize life events, the narrative you enter is sent as written after the disclosure; birth details and chart data are not attached.

reset.title: Reset chart / start fresh
reset.description: Erase your chart and start over from onboarding. This removes every chart, profile, life event, chat and saved interpretation on this device. Your language and AI-endpoint settings — and the already-downloaded engine — are kept.
reset.modal_body: This permanently erases everything on this device: every chart and profile, your life events, all chat history, and saved interpretations.
reset.modal_preserved: Kept: your chosen language, your AI-endpoint settings, and the already-downloaded chart engine — so a new chart is fast.

regen_modal.title: Confirm Changes
regen_modal.intro: Saving these changes will trigger a regeneration of your personal astrological data.
regen_modal.impact_interpretation_detail: AI will generate a new analysis based on corrected data.
regen_modal.impact_chat_detail: Current chat session will be cleared to prevent inconsistent advice.
regen_modal.insufficient: Insufficient tokens for this operation. Please upgrade your plan or wait for your monthly reset.
regen_modal.flip_ack: This changes your rising sign {{from}} → {{to}} and shifts every house in your chart. I understand and want to continue.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.subtitle: Move all durable data — profiles, charts, current timing, life events, readings, relationship readings, chat, and settings including your AI key — to another browser. For example, export in Chrome and import in iOS Safari. Nothing is uploaded.
backup.export_hint: Downloads one timestamped .almamesh file: an encrypted copy of AlmaMesh's canonical SQLite database, including profiles, charts, current timing, life events, readings, relationship readings, chat, and AI settings. You need this password to import it.
backup.sensitivity_note: The password encrypts this transfer file only. Enter it once when importing; normal AlmaMesh launches do not ask for it. Keep it safe — it can't be recovered.
backup.import_hint: Imports a .almamesh backup from another browser and replaces this browser's local state. Enter the file password once; AlmaMesh installs a normal local SQLite database with no recurring prompt. Older .sqlite3 and .json backups also work. An encrypted copy of your current data is saved first.
backup.safety_passphrase_hint: This older backup has no reusable password. Choose one to encrypt the current browser's safety copy before anything is replaced.
backup.error_safety_passphrase_required: Choose a password of at least 8 characters for the encrypted safety backup.
backup.confirm_title: Replace all data on this browser?
backup.confirm_body: This replaces your current profiles, charts, life events, readings, relationship readings, chats, and AI settings with the backup. Before replacement, AlmaMesh will download an encrypted safety copy of your current data so you can undo this.
backup.confirm_safety_download: Confirm that the encrypted safety backup appears in Downloads, then continue.
backup.confirm_safety_ok: I have the safety backup — restore
backup.passphrase_prompt_body: This backup is password-protected. Enter its password to restore.
backup.note_unlinked_chat_one: {{count}} chat conversation was started on a chart that no longer exists. It is in the backup in full, just no longer linked to that chart.
backup.note_unlinked_chat_other: {{count}} chat conversations were started on a chart that no longer exists. They are in the backup in full, just no longer linked to that chart.
backup.note_dropped_readings_one: {{count}} AI reading belonged to a chart that no longer exists and was left out. You can generate a new reading anytime.
backup.note_dropped_readings_other: {{count}} AI readings belonged to charts that no longer exist and were left out. You can generate new readings anytime.
backup.note_dropped_records_one: {{count}} saved record belonged to a person who is no longer on this device and was left out.
backup.note_dropped_records_other: {{count}} saved records belonged to people who are no longer on this device and were left out.
backup.status_export_started: Backup download started. Confirm the file appears in Downloads before relying on it.
backup.error_bad_format: That file isn't an AlmaMesh backup.
backup.error_too_new: This backup is from a newer version of AlmaMesh. Update the app first.
backup.error_bad_passphrase: Wrong password, or the file was changed after export. Nothing was imported.
backup.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
backup.error_safety_cancelled: Import cancelled — we couldn't save a backup of your current data first, so nothing was changed.
backup.confirm_legacy_note: This is an older backup format. AlmaMesh will import what it contains and preserve it in the current canonical database format.
backup.error_passphrase_required: Choose a password of at least 8 characters. It encrypts the file, including your AI key.
backup.error_storage_unavailable: This browser can't open AlmaMesh's local database (it needs OPFS and cross-origin isolation, which private windows often block). Try a normal window in a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari.
backup.error_import_failed: Restore failed: {{reason}}. Nothing was replaced; try again or restore the safety copy.
backup.error_import_requires_durable_storage: Import needs durable browser storage. Open AlmaMesh in a normal browser window where on-device storage is available; a session-only restore would disappear on reload.
